description: Header file defining the AudioFormatAdapter template class for audio processing, including configuration and sample format conversion methods.

classes.name: AudioFormatAdapter
classes.description: Template class providing an adapter for audio processing with configurable format and buffer behavior.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the adapter with processor, channels, format, and behavior.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a block of audio samples, handling format conversion and buffer management.

methods.name: ConvertInput
methods.description: Converts input buffer samples to internal audio_sample_t format.

methods.name: ConvertOutput
methods.description: Converts internal audio_sample_t buffer to output format and buffer behavior.

methods.name: MixOutput
methods.description: Mixes internal buffer samples into output buffer for accumulate behavior.
